crossRefs.note: As a dog that returns to his vomit, so is a fool who repeats his folly.

translations.web: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”
translations.bsb: Of them the proverbs are true: “A dog returns to its vomit,” and, “A sow that is washed goes back to her wallowing in the mud.”
translations.kjv: But it is happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog is turned ➔ to his own vomit again; and the sow that was washed to her wallowing in the mire.
translations.asv: It has happened unto them according to the true proverb, The dog turning to his own vomit again, and the sow that had washed to wallowing in the mire.
